lines.en: B No, I didn't hear anything. I heard nothing.
No, I didn' t speak to anyone. I spoke to nobody.
No,I didn't go anywhere. I went nowhere.
No, I didn't buy anything. I bought nothing.
No,I didn't write to anybody. I wrote to nobody.
No, I didn't meet anyone. I met no one.
C Everyone's looking out of the window.
D No, I haven't got anything to eat. I've got nothing to eat.
No, I haven't got anything to do. I've got nothing to do.
No, I haven't got anything to drink. I've got nothing to drink.
No, I haven't got anything to read. I've got nothing to read.
